messages:
alex: FYI I pushed changes for PR #3421 — addressed the review comments and split the big change into two commits per Sasha's suggestion. PTAL when you have a minute. I added a unit test for the batcher edge-case and a short note in the changelog. CI is running. If anyone would rather I squash to a single commit for release, say so.
sasha: thanks — will pull and smoke test this morning. I generally prefer separate commits for traceability unless release specifically wants a squash.
julia: quick question: did you intentionally change the kv cache behavior? I noticed an explicit cache.clear() removed in runtime/batcher.py — just want to make sure we won't regress warm-up perf.
alex: yep, intentional. I replaced the unconditional clear with a conditional invalidate so we preserve prefix caches in the common path. Small snippet:
```python
# keep prefix entries to avoid refill latency
if not keep_prefix:
    kv_cache.invalidate(prefix)
else:
    # intentionally no-op to preserve prefix warm cache
    pass
```
kevin: CI pipeline passed on dedicated-gpu-2 :white_check_mark: — unit, lint, integration all green.
ci-bot: build 3421 (branch/ptal-split) — ✅ all checks passed: lint, unit-tests, integration-tests.
sasha: left one tiny nit about the log message (log level + wording). I suggested a one-line change inline. PTAL @alex.
alex: addressed that nit, pushed a fixup, and rebased onto main. Force-pushed. Did a quick local smoke with the small loadgen — latency numbers look unchanged.
julia: LGTM aside from the log wording (Sasha's nit). After that I'm happy to approve.
alex: fixed the log wording per Sasha's suggestion and bumped the changelog entry. Thanks — merging after 10:00am PST unless anyone objects.
kevin: no objections from me :thumbsup:
alex: merging now. I'll watch post-merge metrics and revert if any unexpected flake shows up. Thanks everyone for the quick reviews!
